item.title: Man found not guilty of murder after surveillance video raises questions about evidence at Norfolk scene
item.description: Shaiqui McKesson spent 7 months in solitary confinement at the Norfolk jail before a jury found him not guilty of first-degree murder. His defense attorney says a surveillance video was crucial.

item.title: Protesters in Norfolk push back on rising Dominion Energy power bills
item.description: Residents say their bills have jumped by hundreds of dollars. Dominion Energy says a cold winter, fuel costs, and other charges are to blame, but options are available to help customers.

item.title: Robinsons look to help Eagles soar to state title
item.description: Things can get competitive in Dwight Robinson's household. Everybody under the roof loves to win, no matter what the activity.
